bias.en: Bearish · basing above $122, MACD near a cross
bias.zh: 看空 · 在 $122 上方筑底，MACD 接近交叉

read.en: Corning rose 2.4% on Nov 3 to $126.14, trading between $125.36 and $129.85. It is just below the falling 5-day ($126.6) and 10-day ($126.9), and below the falling 30-day ($143.2) and 100-day ($160.2) and the rising 200-day ($156.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($130.16), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 康宁 11月3日上涨 2.4%，收于 $126.14，盘中区间 $125.36–129.85。股价略低于下行的 5 日（$126.6）和 10 日均线（$126.9），并位于下行的 30 日（$143.2）、100 日均线（$160.2）和上行的 200 日均线（$156.0）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收敛、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$130.16），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close cleared the $125.4–126.0 resistance; the $129.85 high pushed through the $128.2–128.6 highs but stopped short of the SAR and faded. Resistance is $126.6–126.9 (5 and 10-day), then $129.85–130.2 (Nov 3 high, SAR) and $132.6–133.2 (Oct 28–29 highs). Support is $125.4, then $121.8–122.8 and $120.0–120.5. A close above $130.2 would flip the SAR and target $132.6–133.2; below $121.8, $120.

s.en: Oct 22, Oct 23, Oct 26 and Oct 27 lows ($121.8–122.8); Nov 2 low $122.4
